Class AbstractLocal

java.lang.Object
sootup.core.jimple.common.AbstractLocal
All Implemented Interfaces:
EquivTo, Immediate, Local, LValue, Value, JimpleIR, Acceptor<ImmediateVisitor>
public abstract class AbstractLocal extends Object implements Local
Shared immutable implementation of Local.

Prefer to use the factory methods in Jimple.

Author:
Linghui Luo
